recipes.name: Baked Chicken Breast
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F. In a medium baking dish, place chicken breasts, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
Using tongs or hands, move chicken around to coat on all sides evenly (I place bottom of breast on top of seasoned one and then swoosh around).
Bake for 25 minutes (under 2') to 35 minutes (2'+) or until instant read thermometer inserted in the thickest part reads 150 degrees F / 65 C.
Remove chicken breasts from the oven, cover with foil or lid, and let rest for 10 minutes for the juices to settle. Don't skip.
Slice against the grain and serve along any side with a salad. Meal prep for the week, use in salads and casseroles.

recipes.name: Chicken Stroganoff
instructions: Generously salt and pepper the chicken and then dust with the flour.

Heat a frying pan over medium-high heat until moderately hot and then melt the butter. Add the chicken in a single layer and let it fry undisturbed until browned on one side (about 5 minutes). Flip and then brown the other side.

Transfer the chicken to a bowl and then add the mushrooms. Spread the mushrooms into a single layer and sauté on one side until they've started to brown and then flip and brown the second side (about 5 minutes per side). As the mushrooms cook on each side, they will release a lot of liquid. You want to wait until all the liquid evaporates before you continue.
Add the onions and continue sauting until the both the mushrooms and onions are well browned (another 10 minutes).
Deglaze the pan with the vermouth, boiling until most of the liquid is gone

Add the chicken stock, tomato paste, bay leaf and thyme, and then return the chicken to the pot. Simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes covered. Remove the lid and simmer for another 10 minutes or until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.
While the chicken is cooking, put the sour cream in a bowl and bring up to room temperature.
When the chicken is done, transfer a few spoonfuls of sauce into the sour cream and stir together and repeat until the sour cream is lukewarm. Pour this mixture back into the pan and stir to combine.
Adjust salt to taste. Serve the Stroganoff with buttered egg noodles or rice.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Gyros recipe

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar (or red wine or apple cider vinegar)
cucumbers (to make about 1/2 ~ 3/4 cup grated cucumber after squeezing out juice)
extra virgin olive oil (or more if you want richer)
red spanish onion , peeled and finely chopped
pita breads or flat breads to serve

instructions: Place the Marinade ingredients in a ziplock bag and massage to mix. Add the chicken into the ziplock bag and massage to cover all the chicken in the Marinade. Marinate for at least 2 hours, preferably 3 hours, ideally 12 hours and no longer than 24 hours.

Make the Tzatziki: Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise. Use a teaspoon to scrape the watery seeds out. Coarsely grate the cucumber using a box grater. Then wrap in paper towels or a tea towel and squeeze to remove excess liquid.
Place cucumber in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients then mix to combine. Set aside for at least 20 minutes for the flavours to meld.
Salad: Combine ingredients in a bowl.
Cook Chicken: Brush the outdoor grill with oil, then preheat on medium high. Or heat 1 tbsp of oil in a fry pan over medium high heat.
Remove chicken from Marinade. Cook the chicken for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through (cooking time depends on size of chicken).
Remove the chicken from the grill / fry pan onto a plate. Cover loosely with foil and allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Assemble Gyros: If your chicken thighs are large, you may need to cut them. Mine were small.

Get a pita bread or flatbread (preferably warmed) and place it on a piece of parchment (baking) paper (or you could use foil). Place some Salad down the middle of the bread, then top with chicken and Tzatziki.
Roll the wrap up, enclosing it with the parchment paper. Twist the end with the excess parchment paper to secure it and cut if desired.
I prefer to lay everything out on a table and let everyone help themselves.

recipes.name: No-fuss shepherds pie

ingredients.name: pita breads or flat breads to serve

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sunflower oil in a medium saucepan, then soften 1 chopped onion and 2-3 chopped carrots for a few mins.
When soft, turn up the heat, crumble in 500g lamb mince and brown, tipping off any excess fat.
Add 2 tbsp tomato puree and a large splash of Worcestershire sauce, then fry for a few mins.
Pour over 500ml beef stock, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook for 40 mins, uncovering halfway.

Meanwhile, heat the oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4, then make the mash. Boil the 900g potato, cut into chunks, in salted water for 10-15 mins until tender. Drain, then mash with 85g butter and 3 tbsp milk.
Put the mince into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash and ruffle with a fork. The pie can now be chilled and frozen for up to a month.

Bake for 20-25 mins until the top is starting to colour and the mince is bubbling through at the edges. (To bake from frozen, cook at 160C/fan 140C/gas 3 for 1 hr-1 hr 20 mins until piping hot in the centre. Flash under the grill to brown, if you like.)
Leave to stand for 5 mins before serving.

recipes.name: Vegan vegetable curry recipe
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 7 mins until starting to soften. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for a further 3 mins then stir in the chilli and dried spices. Season, then cook for 1 min.

Add the aubergine along with the chopped tomatoes and stock. Bring to a simmer, cover the pan and cook for 10 mins. Add the courgette and cook for 25 mins, taking the lid off for the final 10 mins, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the rice to pack instructions.
Once the sauce has thickened and the vegetables are tender, stir through the spinach and peas. Allow to heat through for 3-4 mins so that the spinach has wilted and the peas are tender.
Season to taste, then serve with the cooked rice and a scattering of coriander.

recipes.name: Salt & Pepper Tofu (椒鹽豆腐)

ingredients.name: oil (for stir-frying; can re-use oil from deep-fry step) or can be deepfried

instructions: First, cut to separate the green and the white parts of the green onions (3 stalks). We're only using the firmer, more pungent whites for this dish. Dice the green onion whites.
Halve the bell peppers (56.7 g) so that it's easy to scoop out the core and seeds. Cut into strips, and then rotate 90 degrees to dice them.
Smash, peel, and finely mince the garlic (2 clove).
Cut open the package of firm tofu (454 g) and drain away the soaking liquid. Give the tofu a quick rinse with clean water, and then cut into cubes.
My dad cuts it in half horizontally, then from top to bottom, and then halves each section again and again to end up with 36 cubes. These pieces are on the larger side.
The smaller the cubes, the more surface area you'll get for crust. The larger the cubes, the more volume you get in each piece for soft, tender tofu. It's up to you which aspect to prioritize.

Boil hot water (4 cup) in a pot with the heat on high. Add salt (1 tsp) and stir to dissolve. This salt will help to season the tofu. When the water is boiling, add the tofu cubes. Use chopsticks to shift the tofu around so they’re all fully submerged.
Cook for 3 minutes with the lid on, and then lower the heat to low and uncover the pot. Cook for another 2 minutes.
Carefully pour the tofu into a colander to drain the water out. Let it start to cool.

Line a plate with a paper towel (or for more absorbency, a clean kitchen towel). Transfer the tofu cubes onto the lined plate in an even layer. Lay another paper towel (or kitchen towel) on top and gently press to remove excess moisture.
Spread a layer of cornstarch (4.8 tbsp) on a separate, large plate. Transfer the tofu into a bowl and add the beaten egg. Gently mix to evenly coat the tofu.
Transfer the egg-covered tofu cubes to the cornstarch plate, making an even layer of individual cubes. Don't stack them, or it'll be hard to coat them correctly.
Sprinkle more cornstarch (1.2 tbsp) over the top of the tofu. Use chopsticks to flip and mix the tofu until all the pieces are evenly coated in cornstarch.
Add oil (454 g) to a large pot and set the heat on high.
As the oil heats, mix together garlic salt (1 tbsp) and white pepper (0.25 tsp) in a separate bowl. This will be added to the stir-fry at the very end.
Prepare a batch of dredged tofu in a spider strainer. If you're not used to deep-frying several items at once and are worried about them sticking together, we recommend cooking in smaller batches.

When the oil reaches 400F (or 200°C), carefully set the tofu in the oil. At the beginning, let the tofu cook undisturbed so that the crust can set. If you move the tofu too soon, the batter will fall right off and you won't get a crust on the tofu.

When the tofu has started to set and the oil has started to recover from the temperature drop, you can add the rest of the tofu. Make sure to set them down along the sides of the pot so they don't stick to the other pieces. Gently mix the pieces around so they fry evenly.

When the tofu is golden brown, or after about 5 minutes of frying at 360°-380°F (180-190°C), turn off the heat and carefully remove the tofu. Let the excess oil drain from the tofu. My dad just keeps the tofu in the spider and sets it on a plate from earlier.

Heat a wok on high. Add oil (2 tbsp) (we usually take this from the deep-frying oil). Before the oil gets too hot (before it starts to shimmer or smoke), add the dried chili and stir immediately. Fry for just 8 seconds to extract the flavor, and then remove them.
Add the minced garlic and fry it for 15 seconds, stirring the entire time.
Add the diced bell peppers and green onion whites. Fry for 20-25 seconds, still stirring constantly.
Add the fried tofu and stir-fry for 10 seconds.

While stirring constantly, sprinkle the garlic salt+white pepper seasoning mix over all the ingredients in the wok until the tofu cubes are evenly coated. You probably won't use up all of the seasoning. We only used half of what we prepared.
Turn off the heat and plate. Make sure to scoop up all the little bits of vegetables; they're delicious. Enjoy!

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick frying pan then add 1 sliced onion and cook on a medium heat until completely softened, around 15 mins, adding a little splash of water if it starts to stick.
Crush in 1 garlic clove and cook for 2-3 mins more, then add 1 tbsp butter.
Once the butter is foaming a little, add 250g sliced mushrooms and cook for around 5 mins until completely softened.
Season everything well, then tip onto a plate.
Tip 1 tbsp plain flour into a bowl with a big pinch of salt and pepper, then toss 500g sliced fillet steak in the seasoned flour.
Add the steak pieces to the pan, splashing in a little oil if the pan looks dry, and fry for 3-4 mins, until well coloured.
Tip the onions and mushrooms back into the pan. Whisk 150g crème fraîche, 1 tsp English mustard and 100ml beef stock together, then stir into the pan.
Cook over a medium heat for around 5 mins.
Scatter with some chopped parsley, and serve with pappardelle or rice.

recipes.name: Our Favorite Ground Beef Tacos
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. With ground beef, I rarely add any oil to the skillet because it tends to be fattier. If needed, you can add 1 teaspoon of olive oil (of your oil of preference). Once the skillet it hot, add the ground beef and break it apart with a wooden spoon.

Cook, stirring and breaking apart the beef often, until it begins to brown. Add in the cumin, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, salt and pepper. Stir well to disperse all the seasonings. Cook until the beef is just browned.

I love the seasoned beef like this – it’s a personal preference. If you’d like it saucier, follow the directions below. You can also add in a tablespoon of beef or vegetable stock, or even tomato sauce, to make it saucier.

Serve the ground beef in tacos (warm corn or flour tortillas in the oven for a few minutes), on nachos or in salads. We like to top ours with a quick pico de gallo, fresh cilantro, white cheddar cheese, diced avocado and pickled onions.

If you'd like to add peppers and onions: heat the skillet over medium heat and add 1 to 2 teaspoons of olive oil. Add in 1 diced onion, 1 diced bell pepper and a few minced garlic cloves with a pinch of salt. Toss well and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Proceed with browning the beef above!

For a saucier ground beef: I use a slurry to make my homemade ground beef saucy. Fill a shaker cup with ½ cup cold water or beef/vegetable stock. Add 1 ½ tablespoons all-purpose flour, masa or whole wheat flour to the liquid and cover it. Shake for at least 30 seconds. With the skillet on low heat, slowly stream in the slurry while stirring with a wooden spoon. Stir often and cook over low for about 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Easy chicken fajitas - pan fried
instructions: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and wrap 8 medium tortillas in foil.

Mix 1 heaped tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp ground coriander, a pinch of ground cumin, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 4 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 1 lime and 4-5 drops Tabasco together in a bowl with a big pinch each of salt and pepper.
Stir 2 finely sliced chicken breasts, 1 finely sliced red onion, 1 sliced red pepper and 1 finely sliced red chilli, if using, into the marinade.
Heat a griddle pan until smoking hot and add the chicken and marinade to the pan.
Keep everything moving over a high heat for about 5 mins using tongs until you get a nice charred effect. If your griddle pan is small you may need to do this in two batches.
To check the chicken is cooked, find the thickest part and tear in half – if any part is still raw cook until done.
Put the tortillas in the oven to heat up and serve with the cooked chicken, a bag of mixed salad and one 230g tub of fresh salsa.

recipes.name: Easy Chicken Fajitas - Oven Baked

ingredients.name: Red pepper (capsicum), Deseeded and cut into wedges.
Yellow pepper (capsicum), Deseeded and cut into wedges.
Green pepper (capsicum), Deseeded and cut into wedges.
Large onions, Peeled and cut into wedges.

instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 200C.
Put the oil, chicken chunks, peppers and onions onto a large baking tray. Mix the fajita seasoning ingredients in a small bowl and sprinkle over. Mix thoroughly with clean hands.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the peppers are starting to blacken at the edges.
Serve with the accompaniments and let everyone dig in and build their own fajitas.

recipes.name: Fresh Pico de Gallo Recipe

ingredients.name: jalapeno or serrano peppers, finely diced, with seeds and membranes removed for a milder salsa

instructions: Optional step: To remove the raw bite of your onion, add the chopped onion to a bowl with cold water. Leave for 10 minutes, drain and rinse.
Add the tomatoes, onion, cilantro, diced peppers, and lime juice to a bowl. Generously season with salt (start with 1/2 teaspoon and go from there). Set the pico de gallo aside for 20 minutes.
Stir to distribute the juices left at the bottom of the bowl. Taste and adjust with more salt. Serve!
Pico de gallo is best the day it is made, but it will keep for up to 3 days in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Guacamole

ingredients.name: avocados very ripe but not bruised
coriander leaves and stalks chopped, plus a few leaves, roughly chopped, to serve
chilli red or green, deseeded and finely chopped

instructions: Use a large knife to pulverise 1 large ripe tomato to a pulp on a board, then tip into a bowl.
Halve and stone the 3 avocados (saving a stone) and use a spoon to scoop out the flesh into the bowl with the tomato.

Tip the juice of 1 large lime, a handful of roughly chopped coriander, 1 finely chopped small red onion and 1 deseeded and finely chopped red or green chilli into the bowl, then season with salt and pepper.
Use a whisk to roughly mash everything together. If not serving straight away, sit a stone in the guacamole (this helps to stop it going brown), cover with cling film and chill until needed.

recipes.name: Asian-Style Turkey-Pork Meatballs

ingredients.name: finely chopped spring onion, about 3 stalks
sesame oil, reduce if you don't like it too strong

instructions: Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Set aside.
Combine all the ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Use your hands and mix them together thoroughly.
Scoop about 1 tablespoon of the mix and roll them into meatballs. Place on the lined baking sheet. Freeze the meatballs for at least 1 hour until firm, then store them in a ziploc bag.

To cook the meatballs: Preheat the oven to 190C / 375F. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Place the meatballs on top and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping them once.For more flavour, sear the meatballs in a frying pan until both sides are browned before baking them. Reduce the baking time by 5 to 10 minutes. The meatballs can be served hot, warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Laksa Noodle Soup

ingredients.name: soy sauce , light or all purpose
Sriracha sauce , or other chilli sauce
chilli paste from jar , or more Sriracha

instructions: Chicken Stock: Place Chicken Stock ingredients in a medium saucepan over high heat. Bring to simmer, then reduce to medium high.
Cook for 25 minutes or until chicken flesh is falling off the bone and liquid reduces by about 1/3.
Discard skin, pull flesh off the bone and place in bowl, discard bone. Set broth aside.
Laksa Chilli Sauce: Mix ingredients together in a small bowl. Set aside for 20 minutes.
Laksa Broth: Heat oil in a large saucepan or small pot over medium low heat. Add garlic and ginger, sauté for 20 seconds, then add lemongrass and chillis. Cook for 1 minute.
Add laksa paste. Turn heat up to medium and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, or until fragrant.
Add chicken stock, coconut milk, fish sauce and 2 tsp of Laksa Chilli Sauce. Place lid on and simmer on for 10 minutes.
Adjust to taste using lime juice (for sour) and fish sauce (for saltiness). Add tofu puffs. Leave on turned off stove with lid on for 5 minutes.
Assemble Laksa: Prepare noodles per packet directions.
Divide noodles between 2 bowls. Top with shredded chicken.
Pour broth over chicken. Top with beansprouts. Sprinkle with Garnishes you choose to use. Serve with Laksa Chilli Sauce on the side.
For Recipe notes and advice, check the website.

recipes.name: Easy chicken korma recipe

ingredients.name: brown onions, coarsely grated or very finely chopped
mango chutney or 2 tsp caster sugar
basmati rice, cooked to pack instructions

instructions: Cut each chicken breast into small chunks (roughly 2.5cm) and season generously with freshly ground black pepper. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large nonstick frying pan or wok and fry the chicken until golden over a medium-high heat for 5-6 mins, turning occasionally. Transfer the chicken to a plate using a slotted spoon or spatula and return the pan to the heat. Keep the chicken warm by covering in foil or placing in the oven on a low heat.

Add the remaining oil, butter and onions to the pan and cook over a medium heat, stirring often, for 10 mins, or until the onions are soft and lightly browned. Stir in the ginger and garlic paste and ground spices and cook, stirring continuously, for a further 1 min.

Add the mango chutney and stock to the spiced onions and bring to a simmer. Cook for 5 mins or until the liquid has reduced by roughly half, stirring regularly. (For an extra smooth sauce, blitz the mixture with a blender.)

Return the chicken to the pan with the onions, add the cream and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for 5-6 mins, until the chicken is piping hot and cooked through. Add a splash of water to loosen the sauce if necessary.
Garnish the curry with toasted flaked almonds and scatter with fresh coriander, if you like. Serve with freshly cooked rice.

recipes.name: Easy Thai green curry

ingredients.name: Thai green curry paste (according to taste)
thick stalks lemongrass, fat ends bashed with a rolling pin (optional)
skinless, boneless chicken chicken breast, cut into chunks
makrut lime leaves, torn into pieces (if unavailable, use the grated zest of 1 lime)
Thai fish sauce or light soy sauce

instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan. Add the green curry paste and sugar and cook over a fairly high heat for about a minute, stirring with the lemongrass, if using.
Reduce the heat slightly and stir in the chicken pieces and lime leaves or zest until coated in the paste.

Add the coconut milk, fish sauce or soy sauce and bring to a simmer, cooking for 25–30 minutes until thickened slightly. Stir in the coriander and lime juice. Check for seasoning, adding more fish sauce or soy sauce if needed.

The curry is now best left to sit for a few minutes so the sauce becomes creamier. You will also taste the true flavours of the curry paste ingredients when it's slightly cooler. Serve with lots of fragrant Thai jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Keema (Ground Beef Curry)

ingredients.name: Kashmiri red chili powder see note
green chilies finely chopped, seeds removed for less heat, or Serrano/jalapeño
beef stock low sodium, or water
fenugreek leaves or mint leaves, chopped or 1 tablespoon dried

instructions: Heat oil in a saute pan at medium high. Add chopped onions and saute until light brown, about 5 minutes.
Then add ground beef, and using a wooden spoon break it up into smaller pieces. Cook the meat at medium heat until juices dry up and meat is no longer pink, stirring in between, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger paste, garlic paste and continue to cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Next add garam masala, chili powder, turmeric, salt and black pepper. Continue to cook, stirring and making sure not to burn the spices, about 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste, followed by yogurt and cook the mixture, stirring in between to make sure everything is combined well, about 2 to 3 minutes.

Add green chilies and stock or water. Raise the heat to high, and when the sauce begins to sizzle, reduce the heat to medium-low. Cover with a lid and allow to simmer until the meat is tender, about 10 minutes.

Then add potatoes and half the herbs (cilantro and fenugreek leaves). Make sure that the sauce is not too thick or sticking to the bottom of pan. Add some water if needed. Stir well, cover and let it simmer until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 10 minutes.

Remove the lid and evaporate any excess liquids. The curry sauce should be reddish brown, thick and not too runny. Some red colored oil will trickle to the surface. Garnish with remaining herbs and lemon juice. Serve it hot with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Cauliflower cheese

ingredients.name: large cauliflower (leaves cut off), broken into pieces

instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, then add 1 large cauliflower, broken into pieces, and cook for 5 mins – lift out a piece to test, it should be cooked.
Drain the cauliflower, then tip into an ovenproof dish. Heat oven to 220C/200C/gas 7.
Put the saucepan back on the heat and add 500ml milk, 4 tbsp flour and 50g butter.

Keep whisking fast as the butter melts and the mixture comes to the boil – the flour will disappear and the sauce will begin to thicken. Whisk for 2 mins while the sauce bubbles and becomes nice and thick.
Turn off the heat, stir in most of the 100g grated cheddar cheese and pour over the cauliflower. Scatter over the remaining cheese, and 2-3 tbsp breadcrumbs if using.
Put in the oven and bake for 20 mins until bubbling.

recipes.name: Honey-glazed ham

ingredients.name: sprig thyme 2 bay leaves and 1 rosemary sprig tied together
bay leaves and 1 rosemary sprig tied together

instructions: Put the gammon in a large, deep saucepan. Add the tied herbs, onion, carrots, celery, peppercorns and cloves. Pour over enough cold water to cover the meat, then bring to the boil, cover with a lid, and lower to a gentle simmer for 1 hr 15 mins. Turn off the heat and leave the ham to sit in the liquid for 30 mins.

Remove from the liquid (this makes a delicious soup stock) and leave to cool until cold enough to handle. Peel off the thick layer of skin on the gammon to reveal a layer of fat. Discard the skin and score the fat in a criss-cross pattern with a sharp knife.

Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the ham in a roasting tray lined with foil. Mix together the mustard, honey and sugar in a bowl, then generously brush half over the ham. Roast for 15 mins, then brush with the remaining glaze. Return to the oven for a further 20-30 mins or until sticky and brown. Leave to cool for 15 mins before carving into thick slices.

recipes.name: Baked Lemon Garlic Salmon
instructions: Get ready. Position one oven rack in the center and one rack about 6 inches from the broiler. Preheat your oven to 375°F. Line a sheet pan longways with a large piece of foil, large enough to fold over the salmon. Brush the foil with extra virgin olive oil.

Make the lemon-garlic sauce. Zest one of the lemons into a small bowl or measuring cup, then add the juice from both lemons. Add the extra virgin olive oil, garlic, oregano, paprika, and black pepper and whisk to combine.

Prepare the salmon. Pat the salmon dry and season well on both sides with salt. Place it on the foil, skin side down. Carefully pour the lemon garlic sauce on top, bending the foil upwards around the fish to contain the liquid. Use a spoon or a pastry brush to spread the sauce evenly across the surface of the fish. Slice half of the remaining lemon into rounds and the other half into wedges, and place the rounds on top of the salmon.

Wrap the salmon in foil. Fold the loose end of the foil up and over the salmon, tenting it high enough so there’s an air pocket between the foil and the lemons on top of the salmon. Crimp the foil closed at the top and sides to encase the fish and trap the steam. If you didn’t leave quite a long enough piece of foil, simply tear off another sheet and crimp the two together.
Bake the salmon. Bake in the hot oven until the salmon is almost cooked through at the thickest part (see note),15 to 20 minutes.

Broil the salmon. Carefully remove the pan from the oven and open the foil, folding it out to reveal the top of the salmon. Turn your broiler to high and place the salmon under the broiler briefly, until the top is lightly browned and the salmon is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Watch closely as it broils to make sure it doesn’t overcook and the lemons and garlic do not burn. Remove the salmon from the oven (see note).
Serve. Sprinkle the salmon with the parsley and serve with the lemon wedges on the side.

recipes.name: Easy Fall Off the Bone Oven Baked Ribs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275F (135C). Set aside a large roasting pan or rimmed baking sheet and foil.
If your ribs still have the thin membrane covering the back of the rack, remove it. The tips section below explains how.
Season both sides of the ribs generously with salt and pepper. If you are using a spice rub, rub it over the ribs.

Place the ribs, meatiest-side up, in a large roasting pan. You may need to cut the ribs in half to fit them into the pan. Cover the pan or baking sheet tightly with aluminum foil. It is important they are well sealed inside the foil. If your foil does not wrap all the way around your baking sheet, wrap the rack in tight foil packets and place them on the baking sheet.

Bake the ribs until the meat falls easily from the bones, 2 to 3 hours. I check the ribs after 2 hours to see how they are doing. Ribs are ready to come out of the oven when the meat is cooked through and tender. To check, pierce them with a sharp knife. There should be little to no resistance. You can also gently bend the ribs. If the meat looks like it will easily pull away from the bone, they are ready.

Make Homemade BBQ Sauce: While the ribs bake in the oven, make the barbecue sauce. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until soft and translucent, 5 to 8 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Add the ketchup, hot chili sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar. Stir to combine, season with salt, then cook for 2 minutes. Set aside while the ribs finish baking.
To Finish: Remove the ribs from the oven, discard the aluminum foil, and generously brush both sides with barbecue sauce.

(Optional) Move an oven rack near the top of the oven. Turn the broiler to high and broil the ribs until the barbecue sauce begins to caramelize, 3 to 4 minutes. Keep a close eye on the ribs while they broil so the sauce does not burn.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Fries (Baked)

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes medium size, orange or red color
salt additional salt for seasoning the cooked fries
pepper additional pepper for seasoning the cooked fries

instructions: Fried Sweet Potato Fries: Wash and peel 4 medium sized sweet potatoes
Cut the sweet potatoes into 3/8 inch wide sticks.
Rinse the sweet potatoes in cold water twice. Discard the water between each rinse.
Boil the fries in water for 4 minutes until slightly tender. Remove fries and place them in an ice bath.
Prepare a batter for the fries by stirring together 2/3 cups of cornstarch with an equal amount of water in a bowl.
Season the batter with 2 teaspoons of salt and 3/4 teaspoons of pepper.
Dip the fries in the batter and let them rest for 2 minutes on paper towels.
Heat a pot of vegetable oil to 350 degrees F.
Deep fry the sweet potato fries in batches of 7-15 depending on the size of your pot. Make sure to break up clusters of fries and prevent fries from sticking to the pan as they cook.
Cook the fries for 5-7 minutes or until golden.
When the fries are done cooking, set them in a single layer on paper towels to drain.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste and serve them hot and crispy. Top with parsley if desired.

recipes.name: One-tray chicken wings recipe

ingredients.name: olive oil, plus extra to drizzle

instructions: Preheat the oven to gas 6, 200C, fan 180C. Put the red onion, peppers, tomatoes, chillies and garlic on a large tray. Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil and mix together.

In a large bowl, mix 1 tbsp olive oil with the honey, Cajun seasoning and paprika. Add the chicken wings and toss to coat. Tip the wings onto the baking tray so that they sit on top of the veg. Season.
Roast for 50 mins until the veg are softened and the chicken has crisped up.
Remove from the oven. Set aside the chicken wings and tip the roasted veg into a food processor, along with the remaining olive oil.
Return the chicken wings to the tray and continue to roast for 10 mins until crispy.
Blitz the roasted veg to a smooth sauce and serve with the chicken.

recipes.name: Chunky minestrone soup with gnocchi recipe

ingredients.name: large carrot, peeled and roughly chopped
hot vegetable stock, made with 1 stock cube
basil, chopped (reserving a few leaves to garnish)

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and add the onion, garlic, carrot and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins until the onion has softened.
Stir through the vegetable stock, red wine, chopped tomatoes and oregano. Cover and cook for 20 mins, stirring occasionally.
Stir through the kale and cannellini beans and simmer uncovered for a further 5 mins. Stir through the gnocchi and chopped basil and cook for a further 2 mins. Season to taste.
Divide between 4 bowls and serve topped with shavings of Parmesan and the reserved basil leaves.

recipes.name: Easy hummus
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor, combine the tahini and lemon juice and process for 1 minute. Scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl, then process for 30 seconds more. This extra time helps “whip” or “cream” the tahini, making the hummus smooth and creamy.How to Make Hummus-Recipe-Step-1

Add the olive oil, minced garlic, cumin, and a 1/2 teaspoon of salt to the whipped tahini and lemon juice. Process for 30 seconds, scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl, and then process for another 30 seconds or until well blended.

Drain the chickpeas. Then add half of the chickpeas to the food processor and process for 1 minute. Scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl, then add the remaining chickpeas and process them until thick and relatively smooth, 1 to 2 minutes.

The hummus will likely be too thick and still have tiny bits of chickpea. To fix this, slowly add 2 to 3 tablespoons of cold water or aquafaba with the food processor turned on until you reach the perfect consistency.How-to-Make-Hummus-Recipe-Step-3
Taste and adjust as needed. Serve hummus with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of paprika, sumac, or Za’atar.
Store homemade hummus in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to one week. Freeze, covered with a thin layer of olive oil, for up to one month.

recipes.name: Italian baked meatballs
instructions: Put the onions and 2 tbsp oil in your biggest frying pan, and fry gently until softened. Add the garlic, then increase the heat and fry for a few minutes. Scoop half the softened onions from the pan into a large mixing bowl.

Add the bay leaves, tomatoes, passata, purée, brown sugar and red wine vinegar to the frying pan, and bring to a simmer. Bubble for 20 minutes until the sauce has reduced and thickened, and the surface is glistening. Season.

When the reserved onions have cooled, add the beef mince, breadcrumbs, fennel seeds, oregano and egg with plenty of seasoning. Mix everything with your hands really well, then shape into 20 meatballs. Heat 1tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan and brown the meatballs in batches, adding more oil as you need – the meatballs should be almost cooked through. Cool. Mix 200g of the grated mozzarella with the mascarpone and a little salt.
When everything has cooled to room temperature, combine the meatballs and tomato sauce in a big baking dish. Blob over the cheesy mascarpone, and scatter over the remaining mozzarella. Freeze now.

Heat the oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Cover the dish tightly with an extra layer of foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for a further 30-45 minutes, until the meatballs are piping hot and cooked through, and the cheesy top is golden and bubbling. Let the dish cool for 5 minutes, then add a drizzle of olive oil and a scatter of fresh oregano, if you like, before spooning straight from the dish. Serve with crusty bread, pasta or rice.

*Freezing notes: Open-freeze in the baking dish until solid, but don’t leave it for too long, then cover with a layer of foil, then clingfilm to keep airtight (use clingfilm on its own and you risk taking off the cheesy topping when you remove it), or freeze in individual baking dishes in the same way. The day before you want to bake them, transfer the frozen dish to the fridge. When defrosted, finish the dish as above.

recipes.name: Greek Lamb Chops
instructions: Using paper towels, pat dry chops and discard any shards or bone fragments.
Mix all of the ingredients together in a small jug or bowl.

Arrange lamb chops in a large baking dish or on a large plate, and pour the marinade all over the lamb, rubbing it into the meat. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate for half an hour, or for a deeper flavour, marinate overnight in the refrigerator, turning the chops from time to time (before cooking, let lamb chops sit at room temp 30 minutes).

Heat oil in a pan (cast iron preferably or grill plates) over high heat until just starting to smoke. Fry or grill lamb in 2 batches for 3-4 minutes each side, depending on thickness until done to your liking. (Usually, at 3 minutes per side they are medium, and at 4 minutes they are medium-well.)
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Sprinkle with a little extra dried oregano for added flavour and a little extra lemon juice (optional).

recipes.name: Authentic Italian Lasagna Bolognese
instructions: Make the Bolognese Sauce
Place the minced pancetta in a saucepan. Cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring with a wooden spoon from time to time.
Add the extra virgin olive oil and the finely chopped vegetables. Stir and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring. Then add the ground beef
Stir and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Now put the heat on high and add the white wine. Stir and let it evaporate.

Add the tomato passata. Cover with a lid and simmer over low heat for about 2 hours, adding broth when needed. Towards the end, add the milk to dampen the acidity of the tomato. Season with salt and pepper.
Make the Bechamel Sauce

In a saucepan, melt the butter over low heat then add the flour – using a flour sieve – while mixing quickly with a whisk. Set aside and let it cool. Meanwhile heat the milk, without bringing to a boil.

Pour the milk slowly over the butter+flour, while stirring vigorously with a whisk to prevent the formation of lumps. When the milk is completely poured put the saucepan back on low heat. Keep mixing constantly, until you have a fairly thick consistency (about 10/15 minutes). Add a pinch of fine salt and grated nutmeg to taste.
Make the Layers

Spread on the bottom of a baking dish two tablespoons of bechamel. Then put lasagna noodles over it, trying to cover the entire bottom of the pan. Layer on two tablespoons of bolognese sauce and two of bechamel sauce.
Sprinkle two tablespoons of grated Parmigiano. Repeat these steps for at least five layers (lasagna – bolognese sauce – bèchamel – parmigiano -repeat), in any case up to fill your baking dish.
Cover the last layer with plenty of Parmigiano cheese. Bake at 190°C (380°F) for about 30 minutes. Let cool Lasagna Bolognese for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Butter bean and tomato stew with garlic bread

ingredients.name: dried oregano, plus an extra pinch
butter beans (2 x 400g tins), rinsed and drained
crusty white bloomer, cut into 8 slices

instructions: Warm 1 tbsp of the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and soften the onion with a pinch of salt for 6-8 minutes.
Stir in half the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes, about 100ml water (used to rinse out the tins) and 1.5 tsp oregano. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the lemon zest and juice, sugar, beans and spinach. Once the spinach has wilted, simmer for another 10 minutes until thick, loosening with a splash of water if needed.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices under a hot grill for 1-2 minutes per side.
Mix the remaining oil and garlic with half the basil, a pinch of oregano and black pepper. Brush over one side of the toasts and grill for another 1-2 minutes.
Stir the rest of the basil through the stew and serve with the garlic toasts.

recipes.name: Meatball Pasta Bake
instructions: Heat the oil in a large, deep pan over a medium-high heat and brown the meatballs all over. They only need colour on the outside. Set aside and lower the heat to medium.
Fry the onion in the leftover fat until soft and golden, then add the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic for about a minute.
Pour in the passata (rinse the carton with a splash of water and add that too), then the stock, basil, meatballs and a pinch of salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes until the sauce thickens, stirring now and then.
About 10 minutes before the sauce is ready, cook the rigatoni in salted water until just short of al dente. Heat the oven to 200C.
Drain the pasta, stir it through the sauce, tip into a baking dish and top with the mozzarella, then the parmesan.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Irish Beef and Guinness Stew

ingredients.name: large celery stalks, cut into 2cm pieces

instructions: Cut the beef into 5cm chunks, pat dry and season with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over a high heat and brown the beef well in batches. Set aside.
Lower the heat to medium. Cook the garlic and onion for 3 minutes, then add the bacon and cook until browned.
Stir in the carrot and celery, then the flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Guinness, stock and tomato paste, mixing well so the flour dissolves. Add the bay leaves and thyme.
Return the beef and any juices to the pot. The liquid should just cover it.
Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours, then uncover and simmer for another 30-45 minutes until the beef falls apart and the sauce has thickened.
Skim off any fat, adjust the seasoning, remove the herbs and serve with mashed potato.

recipes.name: Easy Pressure Cooker Pulled Pork

ingredients.name: boneless pork shoulder, cut in two

instructions: Use the browning setting to heat the oil, then brown each half of the pork for about 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Add half the barbecue sauce and the water to the pot, then return the pork and its juices.
Cook at high pressure for 75 minutes, then let the pressure release naturally (about 20 minutes).
Lift out the pork and shred it with two forks, discarding the excess fat.
Strain the cooking liquid and keep 120ml of it.
Return the pork to the pot with the remaining barbecue sauce and the reserved liquid. Bring to a simmer, stirring often so the sugary sauce doesn't catch.
Serve in toasted rolls with extra sauce if you like.

recipes.name: Lamb Chops with Garlic Mint Sauce
instructions: Heat a grill pan over a high heat until almost smoking. Season the chops well on both sides.
Whisk the olive oil, garlic, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, chilli flakes and mint together in a bowl.
Lightly oil the pan and sear the chops for 2 minutes, then flip and cook for 2.5 minutes (medium-rare) or 3.5 minutes (medium).
Drizzle the garlic mint sauce over the chops to serve.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Pork Shoulder
instructions: Heat the pot on the highest saute setting until hot. Pat the pork dry and season with salt and pepper.
Add the butter and brown the pork for 5 minutes per side. Set aside.
Saute the onions for 3.5 minutes, the garlic for 1 minute, then the rosemary and bay leaves for 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom.
Stir in the soy sauce and salt, then add the pork and any juices.
Seal and cook at high pressure for 60 minutes. Allow 15 minutes natural release, then vent the rest.
Remove the pork and bring the liquid to a simmer on the saute setting.
Mix the cornflour with the cold water and stir it in a little at a time until the sauce is thick enough. Season to taste.
Slice the pork thinly and spoon the onion sauce over to serve.

recipes.name: Cheesy Potato Bake
instructions: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan) and have a baking dish of roughly 23 x 33cm ready.
Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly, no more than 3-4mm thick.
Put the slices in a pan of water, bring to the boil and cook for exactly 2 minutes. Drain.
Combine the milk and cream in a jug.
Fry the bacon in a little oil over a medium heat until golden, then add the spring onion and garlic for a minute.
Melt in the butter, add the flour and stir for 30-60 seconds.
Gradually stir in the stock, scraping the pan, until you have a paste.
Lower the heat and slowly whisk in the milk and cream until smooth. Add the thyme, salt and pepper and stir until it thickens and just starts to bubble.
Spread a little sauce over the base of the dish, then layer a third each of the potatoes, sauce and cheese. Repeat twice, finishing with cheese.
Bake for 45-50 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Potatoes au Gratin (Dauphinoise)
instructions: Mix the melted butter, cream and garlic in a jug.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Peel the potatoes and slice them 3mm thick.
Spread a third of the potatoes in a baking dish, pour over a third of the cream mixture, then sprinkle with a third of the salt, pepper and thyme and about 75g of the cheese.
Repeat for the second and third layers, but leave the top layer without cheese for now.
Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1.5 hours, until the potatoes in the middle are soft.
Uncover, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 10-15 minutes until golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wings

ingredients.name: parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve

instructions: Heat the oven to 220C and line a large baking tray with baking paper.
Pat the wings dry, then toss them in a bowl with the oil, baking powder, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika.
Spread the wings out in a single layer and bake for 40-45 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Near the end, put the garlic, lemon zest and parsley in a small bowl. Melt the butter and pour it over, stirring to combine.
Toss the hot wings in the garlic butter, then in the parmesan.
Serve with extra parmesan. (Air fryer option: 200C for 20 minutes.)

recipes.name: Grilled Gochujang Chicken
instructions: Put the chicken in a large container.
Mix all the marinade ingredients, pour over the chicken and coat evenly. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Grease and preheat the grill or BBQ. Grill the chicken covered for 5-7 minutes per side, until it reaches 74C inside.
If using, brush the sweet potato and rice cakes with oil and grill them alongside.
Serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Chicken

ingredients.name: large garlic cloves, crushed or minced
fresh parsley, chopped, plus extra to garnish

instructions: Zest and juice one lemon into a large bowl, then whisk in the olive oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, pepper flakes and parsley.
Slice each chicken breast horizontally into two thin cutlets. Pound them a little flatter if needed.
Pat dry, season both sides with salt and pepper, and turn in the marinade. Cover and chill for 30 minutes to 2 hours (no longer).
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Sear the chicken in batches for about 4 minutes per side until golden.
Take the chicken off the heat at 71C inside, cover with foil and rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and slices of the second lemon.

recipes.name: Oven Pork Ribs with Barbecue Sauce

ingredients.name: hard apple cider or apple juice

instructions: Make the sauce: put all the sauce ingredients in a pan and simmer over a medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 45 minutes until thick. Adjust to taste.
Mix the rub ingredients and rub them over both sides of the ribs, mostly on the meaty side. Leave for 20 minutes (or overnight).
Heat the oven to 160C.
Lay the ribs on a tray, pour the cider underneath, cover with foil and bake for 1.5 hours until fairly tender.
Turn the oven up to 180C. Uncover, drizzle with the oil and bake for 15 minutes until the rub is crusty.
Move the ribs to a fresh tray lined with foil and baking paper, and pour the tray juices over them.
Turn the ribs bony side up, brush with sauce and bake for 10 minutes.
Turn meaty side up, brush with sauce and bake for 5 minutes. Repeat 2-3 more times to build a thick glaze.
Cut into portions and serve with the remaining sauce.

recipes.name: Beetroot and Feta Cheese Salad
instructions: Boil the beetroot over a medium heat for about 45 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
Peel off the skins, which should slip off easily, then cut the beetroot and feta into cubes.
Roughly chop the parsley.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, pepper and salt together for the dressing.
Toss the beetroot, feta and parsley with the dressing and serve.

recipes.name: Persian Chicken Wraps

ingredients.name: red onion, thinly sliced into half moons
rocket and pomegranate seeds, to garnish
small bunch fresh mint, finely chopped

instructions: Mix the ras el hanout with a little of the oil to make a paste. Rub it over the chicken and season with salt. If you have time, cover and marinate in the fridge (up to overnight).
Heat a good drizzle of oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the chicken for 8-10 minutes on the first side and 6-8 on the second, until firm to the touch.
For the sauce, mix the mint, yogurt and sumac with a pinch of salt and some black pepper.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes, then slice into strips.
Fill each tortilla with chicken and onion, add a spoonful of yogurt sauce and a drizzle of pomegranate molasses, then finish with rocket and pomegranate seeds.

recipes.name: Italian-Style Bolognese (Ragù)
instructions: Heat the oil and butter in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot, celery and pancetta for about 10 minutes until the onion turns translucent.
Add both minces and brown them, breaking them up completely.
Season, turn up the heat, pour in the wine and let it bubble away for 2-3 minutes.
Stir the tomato puree into the stock, then add it to the pan.
Cover and simmer on a low heat for 2 hours, adding a splash of stock if it starts to dry out.
Cook the pasta, toss it in the sauce and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Mascarpone and Gorgonzola Pasta Sauce Recipe

ingredients.name: short pasta (penne or rigatoni) or tagliatelle

instructions: Bring a large pan of well-salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a mugful of the cooking water.
While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a wide pan over a low heat and soften the garlic for 1 minute without letting it colour.
Add the gorgonzola and milk and stir gently until the cheese has melted.
Stir in the mascarpone until smooth, then season with black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg. Keep the heat low so the sauce doesn't split.
Drain the pasta and toss it into the sauce with the parmesan, adding a splash of the pasta water to loosen it until glossy.
Taste for salt (the gorgonzola is already salty), then serve topped with the walnuts and parsley.

recipes.name: Pea & ham soup

ingredients.name: potato (1 large), cut into small cubes
frozen petits pois or garden peas

instructions: Warm the oil in a large saucepan over a low-medium heat. Add the onion and potato, season, and stir to coat in the oil.
Scrunch up a sheet of baking paper, flatten it out and press it onto the vegetables to seal them in. Cover with a lid and cook gently for 8-10 minutes until the potato is tender and the onion soft.
Remove the paper, add the peas and stock, and bring to the boil. Cook for a couple of minutes until the peas float and are bright green.
Take off the heat and blend with a stick blender until very smooth, then stir in the milk.
Tear in most of the ham, keeping a little back. Return to a simmer and season, bearing in mind the ham is salty.
Serve topped with the remaining ham and a few torn mint leaves.

recipes.name: Cottage pie

ingredients.name: large onion (or 3-4 banana shallots), finely chopped
King Edward potatoes, peeled and chopped

instructions: Heat half the oil in a large heavy pan and soften the onion. Tip it onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and brown the mince over a high heat for 4-5 minutes, in batches if needed.
Return the onion, add the tomato puree and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the flour for another minute.
Pour in the wine, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom, and add the thyme.
Add the stock and simmer for about 45 minutes until the mince is tender and the sauce has thickened. Season and add Worcestershire sauce to taste. Keep warm on a very low heat.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes in salted water for 12-15 minutes until tender. Drain, return to the pan over the heat for a minute to dry, then mash with the butter and milk until smooth. Season.
Heat the grill to high. Spoon the filling into a baking dish, top with the mash and grill for 8-10 minutes until golden.
While it grills, boil the peas for 3-4 minutes, drain and toss with the butter. Serve alongside the pie.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry

ingredients.name: fish sauce, plus extra to taste
white sugar, plus extra to taste
kaffir lime leaves, torn in half
small Japanese aubergines, cut into 1cm slices
crispy fried shallots, coriander and sliced chilli, to garnish

instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over a medium-high heat.
Fry the curry paste with the garlic, ginger and lemongrass for 2-3 minutes until it mostly dries out (keep your face away from the fumes).
Stir in the stock and coconut milk until the paste dissolves, then add the fish sauce, sugar and lime leaves. Bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken, lower the heat to a gentle bubble and cook for 7 minutes.
Add the aubergine and cook for about 5 minutes until soft. Taste and adjust with more fish sauce or sugar.
Add the mangetout for 2 minutes, then stir in the basil and lime juice and take off the heat so the sauce stays bright.
Serve over jasmine rice with the garnishes.

recipes.name: Buta Kakuni (Japanese Braised Pork Belly)

ingredients.name: pork belly, cut into large chunks

instructions: Sear the pork in hot oil for 1-2 minutes per side, in batches so the pan isn't crowded.

Return all the pork with the spring onion, 5 slices of ginger, dashi powder and 600ml water. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently under a lid or a sheet of baking paper for about 1.5 hours until tender.
Lift out the pork. Strain the liquid (it makes a good broth) and discard the ginger and spring onion.
Put the pork back in the pan with the sake, 120ml water, both soy sauces, mirin, sugar and the last slice of ginger. Bring to the boil.
Simmer for about 25 minutes, turning the pork now and then, until the sauce is thick and sticky. Remove the ginger.
Serve with rice, topped with sliced spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Japanese Golden Curry

ingredients.name: chicken thighs or pork shoulder, bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat, brown the meat and set it aside.
Cook the onion until soft and translucent, adding a little more oil if needed.
Add the carrots and cook for a few more minutes.
Pour in the water, bring to the boil, then simmer on low for 10 minutes.
Stir in the curry roux cubes until the sauce thickens, then add the honey.
Return the meat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Takikomi Gohan

ingredients.name: sprigs mitsuba or spring onion, to garnish

instructions: Make the dashi and let it cool. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, soak for 20-30 minutes, then drain well.
Soak the dried shiitake in the water until soft. Squeeze them out (keep the liquid), remove the stems and slice the caps.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss with the sake.
Scrape the gobo skin, halve lengthways, slice diagonally and keep in water. Halve and slice the carrot the same way.
Rinse the aburaage in hot water, squeeze dry, halve and slice thinly.
Mix 2 tbsp of the shiitake liquid with the soy sauce, mirin and salt, then top up with dashi to 360ml.
Toss the chicken, shiitake, gobo, carrot and aburaage in the seasoning liquid.
Spread the rice in the Instant Pot, then layer the mixture and liquid on top without stirring.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 2 minutes. Let it release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release the rest.
Fluff the rice gently and serve garnished with mitsuba or spring onion.

recipes.name: Oyakodon

ingredients.name: sprigs mitsuba or spring onion, chopped

instructions: Mix the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss with the sake. Lightly break up the eggs with chopsticks without fully beating them.
Spread the onion in a frying pan, pour over the sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and cook uncovered over a medium-low heat for about 5 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and the onion is soft.
Turn the heat to medium. Pour about two-thirds of the egg into the centre and let it start to set.
Pour over the rest of the egg, scatter with the mitsuba or spring onion, and cook until done to your liking.
Divide the rice between two bowls, slide the chicken and egg on top with some sauce, and serve straight away.

recipes.name: Miso Yaki Onigiri
instructions: Mix the miso, sugar and mirin into a paste. Adjust the sugar depending on how salty your miso is.
Keep 6 shiso leaves for serving. Roll up the rest and slice into thin strips.
Fluff the warm rice and mix in the shredded shiso and sesame seeds.
Wet your hands, rub on a little salt, and shape the rice into 6 balls. Flatten each into a thick disc without squeezing too hard.
Line a frying pan with baking paper, oil it lightly and cook the discs over a medium heat for about 2.5 minutes until browned underneath.
Oil the tops, flip and brown the other side for about 2.5 minutes.
Lower the heat, brush the miso paste on one side and cook for 10-15 seconds, then repeat on the other side. Watch closely, as miso burns quickly.
Serve each onigiri on a shiso leaf.

recipes.name: Gyudon (Japanese Beef Bowl)

ingredients.name: pickled red ginger (beni shoga), to serve

instructions: Slice the onion and spring onion. Cut the beef into roughly 7cm pieces (part-freezing it makes slicing easier).
Put the dashi, sake, mirin, soy sauce and sugar into a large cold frying pan.
Spread the onion through the liquid and lay the beef over the top.
Cover and bring to a simmer over a medium heat, then lower the heat and cook for 3-4 minutes, skimming off any scum and fat.
Scatter over the spring onion and cover for another minute.
Spoon the rice into bowls, drizzle with some sauce, top with the beef and onion, and finish with pickled ginger.

recipes.name: Authentic Bolognese Sauce (Ragu alla Bolognese)
instructions: Finely chop the carrot, celery, onion and pancetta.
Warm the oil in a large pot and gently cook the vegetables and pancetta for 5-10 minutes until soft but not browned.
Add the mince and brown it, then pour in the wine and let it reduce by half.
Stir in the passata and stock, cover and simmer very gently for 2 hours.
Uncover, stir in the milk and simmer for another hour. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the tagliatelle, toss it through the ragu until coated, and serve.

recipes.name: Instant Pot BBQ Pulled Pork

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 7-8cm chunks
brioche buns or rolls, to serve

instructions: Set the Instant Pot to the high saute setting.
Mix the brown sugar, salt and all the spices, then rub the mixture all over the pork.
Add the oil and brown the pork in two batches, 3-4 minutes per batch.
Pour in the stock and 4 tbsp of the vinegar, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 40 minutes, then quick-release the pressure.
Lift out the pork and shred it with two forks. Stir in the remaining 2 tbsp vinegar and season to taste.
Serve straight away with the BBQ sauce, in buns if you like.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Roast Leg of Lamb with Potatoes

ingredients.name: bone-in leg of lamb, fat trimmed
garlic cloves, sliced (for studding the lamb)
medium potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
extra virgin olive oil (for the rub)

instructions: Take the lamb out of the fridge about 1 hour before cooking.
Blend the 15 garlic cloves, oregano, mint, paprika, nutmeg, 120ml olive oil and lemon juice in a food processor until smooth.
Pat the lamb dry, cut a few slits on both sides and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the lamb on a rack under a hot grill for 5-7 minutes per side until browned. Then set the oven to 160C (140C fan).
Once it's cool enough to handle, push the sliced garlic into the slits and coat the whole leg with the rub. Set it on a rack in a roasting tin and pour the water into the tin.
Toss the potato and onion wedges with the paprika, garlic powder, a little salt and a drizzle of oil, and arrange them around the lamb.
Cover loosely with foil and roast for 1 hour, then uncover and roast for 15-20 minutes more until the lamb reaches 52C inside (medium).
Rest the lamb for 15-20 minutes, then carve and serve with the potatoes, garnished with parsley.
For fall-apart lamb instead: roast covered for 4-4.5 hours, add the potatoes for the last 1-1.5 hours, then uncover for 15-20 minutes.

recipes.name: Waterless Onion Curry (Mizu Nashi Curry)

ingredients.name: new potatoes, unpeeled, cut into chunks

instructions: Trim the excess skin and fat from the chicken and cut it into 4cm pieces. Cut the unpeeled potatoes and the carrot into chunks, and roughly chop the tomato.
Slice the onions thinly across the grain.
Heat the oil in a pot and cook the chicken with half the onions until the onions are lightly golden.
Add the rest of the onions, the carrot, potatoes and tomato. Cover and cook over a low-medium heat for 15 minutes. Don't add any water; the vegetables release their own juices.
Stir well, turn off the heat and stir in the curry roux until fully dissolved.
Warm through over a low heat for about 5 minutes, then serve with rice.

recipes.name: Rich Thai Green Curry (Delish Kitchen-Japanese recipe ver)
instructions: Cut the aubergine into bite-sized chunks, the pepper into 1cm strips and the bamboo shoots into pieces. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp oil over a medium heat and cook the chicken until it turns white. Add the vegetables and bamboo shoots and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, then tip everything out of the pan.
Add the remaining oil, turn the heat to low and fry the curry paste for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in the water and coconut milk and simmer over a medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Return the chicken and vegetables. Once it boils, cover and simmer on low for about 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the sugar and fish sauce, then serve topped with basil, with jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Beef Stifado (Greek Beef Stew)

ingredients.name: pearl onions or small shallots, peeled
chopped tomatoes (1 tin, or 2 ripe tomatoes, skinned)
pasta or new potatoes, to serve

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the beef well in batches, so the oil stays hot. Set aside, covered.
Halve the onions crossways and cook them in the same oil over a medium heat for about 10 minutes until soft but not browned.
Add the cognac, wine and vinegar, cover and simmer for 3 minutes.
Return the beef and its juices, stir in the tomato puree, then add the tomatoes, bay leaf, allspice, nutmeg and enough water to just cover the meat. Bring to the boil.
Lower the heat, cover and simmer gently for about 1.5 hours until the beef is tender and the sauce thick. Add about 120ml boiling water halfway if it looks dry.
Season with salt and pepper towards the end. Serve with pasta and grated cheese, or boiled new potatoes.

recipes.name: Moussaka

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil, for brushing the aubergines
ground nutmeg (half for the sauce, a quarter for the bechamel)
extra virgin olive oil (for the bechamel)

instructions: Slice the aubergines into 6mm rounds (discard the skin-heavy end slices), lay them out, salt and leave for 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil over a medium heat and cook the onion for about 5 minutes until lightly golden. Add the mince and brown well, then drain off excess fat.

Stir in the oregano, cinnamon, pepper, ½ tsp nutmeg, paprika and about ½ tsp salt. Add the wine and bubble for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, sugar and hot stock. Simmer on a medium-low heat for 20-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the grill to high and oil a large baking tray. Pat the aubergine dry, lay in a single layer (in batches if needed) and brush both sides generously with oil.
Grill about 15cm from the heat, turning, until soft and golden on both sides. Watch closely so they don't burn.
Turn the oven to 180C (160C fan) and oil a roughly 24 x 33cm baking dish.

For the bechamel, heat the 110ml oil until shimmering, stir in the flour with ½ tsp salt and some pepper and cook until golden. Gradually whisk in the warm milk and cook over a medium heat for 5-7 minutes until it coats the back of a spoon. Add ¼ tsp nutmeg.
Whisk a ladleful of the hot sauce into the beaten eggs, then whisk this back into the pan. Boil gently for 2 minutes, season, and take off the heat.
Layer half the aubergine in the dish, spread over the meat sauce, then add the rest of the aubergine. Pour over the bechamel and scatter with breadcrumbs.
Bake on the middle shelf for 45 minutes. Grill briefly at the end to brown the top if you like.
Rest for 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast, bite-sized pieces
olive oil (or oil from the sun-dried tomato jar)
sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Toss the chicken with the oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.

Heat a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Spread the chicken out and leave undisturbed for 2-3 minutes until golden, then add the sun-dried tomatoes and cook for 5-7 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, whisk the milk and cornflour together until smooth.
Pour the milk mixture over the chicken and let it bubble for 3-4 minutes until thickened.
Lower to a simmer, add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Turn off the heat, stir in the pasta and parmesan, and serve.

recipes.name: Orata al Forno (Baked Sea Bream with Potatoes)

ingredients.name: whole sea bream, gutted and scaled
lemon, sliced, plus extra to serve

instructions: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan).
Peel the potatoes and slice them about 6mm thick. Toss with a very little olive oil, spread in an ovenproof dish and season.
Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse and pat the fish dry and trim off the side and belly fins. Salt the cavity and stuff with two lemon slices, some of the garlic and a rosemary sprig. Brush both sides with oil.
Uncover the potatoes and scatter over the spring onion and remaining garlic.
Lay the fish on top, sprinkle with salt and bake for 25-30 minutes, brushing with a little more oil if it looks dry. It's done when the top fin pulls out easily.
Scatter with parsley and serve hot with extra lemon, whole or filleted.

recipes.name: Basil Pesto Tomato Mozzarella Chicken Bake
instructions: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan).
Put the chicken in a medium baking dish, season with salt and spread over the garlic.
Spread the pesto evenly over each breast, then top with tomato slices and thick slices of mozzarella.
Bake uncovered for 20-30 minutes, depending on the thickness, until the chicken is cooked through.
Scatter with fresh basil and serve, spooning the pan juices over pasta or rice.

recipes.name: Easy Marinara Sauce

ingredients.name: small handful fresh basil, thinly sliced

instructions: Warm the oil in a large pan over a medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes until soft.
Add the whole tomatoes with their juice and break them up with a spoon.
Stir in the passata, tomato puree, sugar if using, oregano, salt, pepper and water.
Simmer uncovered on a low heat for about 20 minutes until thickened to your liking.
Stir in the basil just before serving over spaghetti. Makes about 2 litres; freezes well.

recipes.name: Perfect Au Gratin Potatoes

ingredients.name: potatoes (e.g. Maris Piper or Yukon Gold), peeled and sliced 3mm thick

instructions: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan).
Melt the butter in a large saucepan over a medium-high heat. Soften the onion for 5-6 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually stir in the milk and cream to avoid lumps. Bring to the boil, then simmer until slightly thickened.
Stir in the cheddar, half the parmesan, the salt and pepper until melted.
Add the potatoes and stir until well coated.
Tip into a 2-litre baking dish, sprinkle with the rest of the parmesan, cover with foil and bake for about 1 hour until the potatoes are tender.
Uncover and bake for another 20 minutes until lightly browned.
Rest for 5 minutes, garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Moussaka with Potatoes (The Greek Foodie)

ingredients.name: large potatoes, e.g. Maris Piper or Yukon Gold (plus 1 extra if needed)
extra virgin olive oil (for frying the vegetables)
extra virgin olive oil (for the ragu)
ground nutmeg (half for the ragu, half for the bechamel)
plain flour, plus extra if needed
whole milk, plus up to 240ml extra to thin

instructions: Ragu: brown the mince in the oil over a high heat, breaking it up. Add the onion, garlic, cinnamon, cloves, cumin and 1 tsp nutmeg and cook until the onion softens.
Stir in the tomato puree for 2-3 minutes, then add the wine and let the alcohol cook off. Add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer on a low heat for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, slice the aubergines about 1cm thick, salt them and leave to drain in a colander for 15 minutes. Pat dry and fry in hot oil for 2-3 minutes until golden. Drain on a wire rack.
Slice the potatoes about 6mm thick, keeping them in water as you go. Drain, pat dry and fry in hot oil for 1-2 minutes until lightly coloured. Drain on a wire rack.

Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Layer the potatoes in a large baking dish and season, then add the aubergine. Remove the cinnamon stick, spread the ragu over the top and sprinkle with a little of the parmesan.

Bechamel: warm the milk with the bay leaf without boiling. In another pan, melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until light blond. Gradually whisk in the warm milk until smooth and thick (add more milk if too thick).
Take off the heat, remove the bay leaf, and season with salt, pepper and the remaining nutmeg. Whisk in the egg yolks and about 100g of the parmesan.
Pour the bechamel over the meat, scatter with the remaining parmesan and bake for about 45 minutes until golden brown.
Leave to rest for 15 minutes before cutting.
